mission_08: Impressive! You have implemented multi-head attention with comprehensive visualization and analysis capabilities. Your implementation correctly computes scaled dot-product attention across multiple heads, applies softmax normalization, and aggregates results through the output projection. The analysis functions compute attention entropy (measuring how focused or diffuse each head's attention is), self-attention ratios (distinguishing positional from contextual attention), and attention flow across layers. Understanding attention patterns is crucial for debugging transformers, identifying failure modes, and building trust in NLP model predictions.
